column1: # Model scope: which production functions are bound to a TLA+ spec.
# scripts/ci/check-model-scope.sh reads this and, for a change that touches one
# of these functions, asks that the spec and its fixture move too. It proves
# nothing -- it turns "the model quietly stopped tracking the code" into a
# review prompt. A change that legitimately does not affect the model passes by
# saying so: put `Model-scope-ok: <reason>` in a commit message or the PR body.
